About Oman National Day

Oman celebrates National Day on 20 November, and its holiday can be moved to other days by decision, as in 2026.

Frequently asked questions

When is Oman National Day 2026?

The day itself is Friday 20 November 2026, and the official holiday is on Wednesday 25 and Thursday 26 November.

Is the National Day holiday for the private sector in Oman?

Yes, official holidays are paid for workers under the Labour Law; working on them earns extra pay.

Sources

  • Oman — Labour Law, Royal Decree 53/2023 (Arabic)
